results.title: Billing and Refunds
results.content:
Billing and Refunds — Monthly plans
Monthly plans renew automatically. If you cancel, you keep access until the end of the paid period. Monthly payments are non-refundable, except for billing errors such as duplicate charges, which we refund in full.

results.title: Billing and Refunds
results.content:
Billing and Refunds — Annual plans
Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days, we offer a prorated refund for unused full months only when you downgrade to a lower annual tier; all such requests are reviewed by our billing team.

results.title: Plans and Seats
results.content:
Plans and Seats
- **Starter** — $19/month, 1 seat, 3 dashboards.
- **Pro** — $49/month, 3 seats, unlimited dashboards, scheduled reports.
- **Team** — $24 per seat/month billed annually, minimum 10 seats, SSO and audit logs.

Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal. Seats can be added at any time from Settings → Members.

Account Access and Security — Locked out of SSO
If your company uses SSO and you are locked out, contact your workspace administrator. Only a workspace owner can change SSO settings.
